entries.description: Warm introductions into crypto, RWA, market making, and allocation, plus network-intelligence coverage scores. Every introduction is double opt-in: a human reviews the request and the target consents before either side learns who the other is. Free human-vetted tier for autonomous agents; paid tiers from $99/mo.
representativeQueries: find me an introduction to a crypto market maker
who can introduce me to an RWA tokenization desk
get me a warm intro to an allocator in digital assets
check whether there is a path to someone at this crypto firm
what does the network know about this trading counterparty
